fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model name sent to the System One endpoint. jev-latest is the TypeSafe model.

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: System One API base URL. The runner posts to {endpoint}/v1/systemone.

fields.name: jev_version
fields.label: JevBench version
fields.description: Public release profile passed to jevbench-public. v1.4.2.2 uses the 231 published public cases.

fields.name: split
fields.label: Split
fields.description: Public items only. public concatenates easy, then original, then hard (231 items) so task_range indexes are stable.

fields.name: task_range
fields.label: Task range
fields.description: Inclusive index range into the chosen split, for example 0-9. Leave empty to run every item in the split.

fields.name: cap_usd
fields.label: Budget cap (USD)
fields.description: Shared ledger cap. Unknown prices reserve $0.02 per decision. A run that hits the cap stops; remaining items stay unattempted.

fields.name: input_token_price
fields.label: Input Token Price (USD per 1M tokens)
fields.description: Optional. Both prices must be greater than 0 or the run stays token-only and cost_usd stays null. 0 is treated as unset.

fields.name: output_token_price
fields.label: Output Token Price (USD per 1M tokens)
fields.description: Optional pair to input_token_price. A partial pair is ignored.

fields.name: request_options
fields.label: Request options JSON
fields.description: Optional JSON object merged into the chat request. A null value removes that field. Example: {"response_format": {"type": "json_object"}}
